env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd caller
logos run .
stdout '^7 reloc$'
stdout '^reloc-write-fault$'
cd ..

-- lib/go.mod --
module example.com/reloc

go 1.27

-- lib/p/values.lgo --
package p

type Data struct {
	N int
	Text string
}

const func makeData() Data {
	return Data{N: 7, Text: "reloc"}
}

const Exported = makeData()

-- caller/go.mod --
module example.com/caller

go 1.27

require example.com/reloc v0.0.0

replace example.com/reloc => ../lib

-- caller/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"strings"
	"unsafe"

	"example.com/reloc/p"
)

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) > 1 {
		q := unsafe.Pointer(&p.Exported.N)
		*(*int)(q) = 9
		fmt.Println("STORE-SUCCEEDED")
		return
	}
	fmt.Println(p.Exported.N, p.Exported.Text)
	exe, err := os.Executable()
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	out, err := exec.Command(exe, "child").CombinedOutput()
	if err == nil || strings.Contains(string(out), "STORE-SUCCEEDED") {
		panic("relocation store did not fault")
	}
	fmt.Println("reloc-write-fault")
}
